description: This file defines a deprecated Python class SlackNotification for sending Slack notifications within the Superset project, including methods for retrieving channels, inline files, and sending messages with error handling.

classes.name: SlackNotification
classes.description: A class for sending Slack notifications, marked as deprecated, with methods to get channels, inline files, and send messages with error handling.

methods.name: _get_channel
methods.description: Retrieves the recipient's Slack channels as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: _get_inline_files
methods.description: Returns a tuple with the file type and list of files (csv, screenshots, or pdf) to be uploaded.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a Slack message or file upload, with error handling and support for v2 API fallback.
